scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Huh? Do I know you? It's creepy that you seem so familiar. You don't have a twin, do you?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
咦？我認識你嗎？
你看起來好眼熟，真是讓人毛骨悚然。
你該不會有個雙胞胎吧？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
What, do you want to be a Thief? I'm sorry, but you look like you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
什麼，你想成為盜賊？
抱歉，你看起來還需要更多訓練。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Take your time and learn all the Basic Skills, will you? Well then, see you later~!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
慢慢來，把基本技能都學會，好嗎？
那麼，下次再見啦~！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Well, I got this feeling like you've been through a lifetime of fighting, so I'm promoting you to a Thief right this minute. I better give you tough guys what you want...
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
總覺得你像是打了一輩子的仗。
好，現在就讓你轉職成盜賊。
你們這些狠角色想要什麼，我還是照辦的好...

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Since you've become a Thief, live as a Thief. Now, go for it! Next~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
既然你成為了盜賊，就要像盜賊一樣生活。
去吧！下一個~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，寶貝~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, dude.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，夥計。
...嘿！你看起來太正經了，不像想當盜賊的樣子！！
快走吧，我很忙。下一個！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guide]
Hey, baby.
...Hey! You look too goody-goody to want to be a Thief!! Now scram, I'm busy. Next!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊嚮導]
嘿，寶貝。
...嘿！你看起來太正經了，不像想當盜賊的樣子！！
快走吧，我很忙。下一個！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Ehh... Seems like a beloved {0} of a rich family, but why are you here in this dirty place?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
呃...看起來像是有錢人家嬌生慣養的{0}，你怎麼會來這種髒地方？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Well, I'm not in charge of making you a Thief. I just accept applications, get it?
If you want to become a Thief, ask the sharp-eyed guy next to me.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
嗯，我不負責讓你轉職成盜賊。我只是負責受理申請，懂嗎？
想成為盜賊的話，去問我旁邊那個目光銳利的傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Hey~ if you have any trouble, get it out to me anytime, huh?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
嘿~ 遇到什麼麻煩，隨時都可以來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
What the heck...?
Huh... you are a {0}, blockhead!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
搞什麼...？你不是{0}嗎，笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
What the heck...?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
搞什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Ehh... Seems like a beloved {0} of a rich family, but why are you here in this dirty place?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
呃...看起來像是有錢人家嬌生慣養的{0}，你怎麼會來這種髒地方？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Hey, brother.
Why are you here? Go back to your place~ go back~~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
嘿，老兄。
你來這裡幹什麼？回你該待的地方去~ 回去~~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Hey, lady.
Why are you here? Go back to your place~ go back~~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
嘿，小姐。
你來這裡幹什麼？回你該待的地方去~ 回去~~

scripts.text: I want to be a Thief.
scripts.translation: 我想成為盜賊

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
You know you cannot be a thief without an application...
What's on your mind...?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
你知道沒有申請書是當不了盜賊的...
你在想什麼呢...？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Well, are you that proud of it?
You're telling me so proudly that you want to be a Thief! Why don't you go to all the villages and advertise yourself for being a thief?
'Ha ha ha! Go put up a banner that says 'I will be a proud thief who steals other people's stuff.'
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
你還挺自豪？想當盜賊也嚷得這麼大聲！乾脆去每個村子宣傳吧？
哈哈哈！掛個橫幅，寫上“我要做個光榮的盜賊，專偷別人東西”！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Do you want to be a thief so badly?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
你就這麼想當盜賊嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: How about you?
scripts.translation: 那你呢？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Oh, do you...? Huh.. well... I do live and learn to see strange people like you.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
哦，是嗎...？呵，真是什麼怪人都能碰見。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Then why are you here? Do you think you can become a thief so easily?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
那你來這裡幹什麼？你以為當盜賊那麼容易嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Eh..? me? me?
Well... I just fit well to being a thief... characteristically... I don't mind this silly matter.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
呃...？我？我？
我嘛...性格比較適合當盜賊，這種小事就不計較了。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Anyway, in the outside world, never say that you want to be a Thief!!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
總之，在外面絕對不要說你想當盜賊！！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
So, do you want to apply for being a Thief?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
那麼，你要申請當盜賊嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是，我要申請

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Well... do what you want to do~ Go your way~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
嗯...你想怎樣就怎樣吧~ 走你的路吧~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Alright, tell me your name. Huh? What?
{0}. So {1}, right...?
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
好，告訴我你的名字。嗯？什麼？
{0}。所以是{1}，對吧...？

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
I can see your strong will to become a Thief......
But only with your will, you cannot make it in a real fight, can you?
So go and reach at least Basic Skill Level 9.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
想當盜賊的決心，我是看出來了...
可真打起來，光靠決心有什麼用？先把基本技能練到9級再來。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Hmm.... I found your interesting criminal records from the data of the detective agency. Well you seem to have what it takes to be a good thief.
{0}. I now declare that you have passed the job interview!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
嗯...偵探社的資料裡，你的犯罪記錄倒挺有意思。
看來是個當盜賊的料。
{0}，我宣佈，你通過面試了！

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Well, I'm not in charge of making you a Thief. I just accept applications, get it?
If you want to become a Thief, ask the guy next to me.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
嗯，我不負責讓你轉職成盜賊。我只是負責受理申請，懂嗎？
想成為盜賊的話，去問我旁邊那個傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Alright. You must have passed the job interview, huh?
Good. I'll accept you.
Let's begin the job-changing ceremony of our guild!
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
好，看來面試已經過了？
行，我們收下你，現在開始公會的轉職儀式！

scripts.text:
[Commander of Thief Guild]
'{0}.'
'For those who are ready, the moonlight shall open the way. Now you are fully ready, I now officially allow you to become a member of the Thief Guild.'
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會指揮官]
“{0}。”
“對於做好準備的人，月光將為其開路。你已完全準備就緒，我正式准許你成為盜賊公會的一員。”

scripts.text:
[Commander of Thief Guild]
'Congratulations on becoming a Thief.'
'From now on, keep the rules of our guild and be an honorable member.'
'If you bring us any disgrace by breaking our rules, you better watch your back.'
'Anyway, I expect you to be a great thief.'
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會指揮官]
“恭喜你成為盜賊。”
“從今以後，要遵守公會的規矩，做一名光榮的成員。”
“如果你違反規矩，讓我們蒙羞，最好小心你的背後。”
“總之，我期待你成為一名偉大的盜賊。”

scripts.text:
[Brad]
Heee~Yaaaa~! Congratulations! My friend.
My name is 'Brad'. I'm in charge of human resources here.
I'm not sure for now but you'll have more chances to see me later on.
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
嘿~呀~！恭喜，朋友！
我叫布拉德，負責這裡的人事。
現在不好說，以後咱們見面的機會可多著呢。

scripts.text:
[Brad]
Okay, I've done what I can do to you, so go on your way. I'm quite a busy man.
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
好了，我能為你做的都做了，你走吧。我可是個大忙人。
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Brad]
I don't have any special events now. So go on your way and come back later.
scripts.translation:
[布拉德]
我現在沒有什麼特別的活動。你先走吧，以後再來。

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Hey~ Hey~ You're not a novice or a thief!
What are you doing here? You're not welcome to make this place your home~ Hweeeee~ Get outta here~
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
嘿，嘿~你既不是初心者，也不是盜賊，來幹什麼？
這裡可不歡迎你賴著不走！噓——快出去~

scripts.text:
[Thief Guildsman]
Ho? Why is a novice like you visiting here?
If you are here to be a Thief, ask the nasty-tempered lady right next to me.
scripts.translation:
[盜賊公會成員]
哦？你這樣的初心者來這裡幹什麼？
如果你想當盜賊，去問我旁邊那位脾氣不好的女士。
